title: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to the Certain Tribal Areas Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to the Certain Tribal Areas Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXVII OF 1973
ACT XXVII OF 1973
SUPREME COURT AND HIGH COURT
(EXTENSION OF
JURISDICTION TO CERTAIN TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 1973
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Act may
be called the Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to
certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to the Certain Tribal Areas Act 1973
sections.description:
Extension of jurisdiction of Supreme Court

ACT XXVII OF 1973
ACT XXVII OF 1973
SUPREME COURT AND HIGH COURT
(EXTENSION OF
JURISDICTION TO CERTAIN TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 1973
2. Extension of
Jurisdiction of Supreme Court.‑The
Supreme Court of Pakistan shall have, in relation to the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalat, Swat and Malakand Protected
Area, the same Jurisdiction as it has in relation to the other areas of the
North‑West Frontier Province.

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to the Certain Tribal Areas Act 1973
sections.description:
Extension of jurisdiction of High Court

ACT XXVII OF 1973
ACT XXVII OF 1973
SUPREME COURT AND HIGH COURT
(EXTENSION OF
JURISDICTION TO CERTAIN TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 1973
3. Extension of
Jurisdiction of High Court.‑The
Peshawar High Court shall have, in relation to the Tribal Areas specified in
section 2, the same Jurisdiction as it has in relation to the other areas of
the North‑West Frontier Province.

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to the Certain Tribal Areas Act 1973
